prompt: I need to secure our contact form `contact-Form.form.yaml` by enabling invisible reCAPTCHA and the built-in honeypot. I want to add a reCAPTCHA element at the end of the form. Can you configure this in `packages/theme-skom/Resources/Private/Forms/contact-Form.form.yaml`?
assertions: Contact Form YAML includes honeypot.enable: true under renderingOptions.
Contact Form YAML includes useInvisibleRecaptcha: true under renderingOptions.
Contact Form YAML includes type: Recaptcha in the renderables list.
Contact Form YAML includes identifier: Recaptcha under the recaptcha renderable validators.
